name: Self Respect
overview: Scripture reveals that true self-respect is rooted in recognizing that we are fearfully and wonderfully made by God, who intimately formed us even before birth (Psalms 139:13-14). This understanding calls believers to a transformed mind that discerns and embraces God's perfect will rather than conforming to worldly standards (Romans 12:2). Furthermore, self-respect is balanced by sober humility, acknowledging that our value comes from God's grace and the faith He has given each of us (Romans 12:3). Ultimately, our identity and worth are found in Christ, who lives in us and empowers our new life (Galatians 2:20).
